factors: A 7:41 product demonstration with six bounded creator-attributed claims
Architecture experiment recommended, with no operational adoption proposed
complexity.rationale: A short demonstration with six materially mapped claims supports the existing standard-length Reader. The analysis proposes proportionate experiments without a consequential architecture-change recommendation.

sourceMap.rationale: The privacy rationale is creator-attributed and not an independent network audit. Private ASR cue was inspected by the publisher, not listening-certified by this reviewer.
Model selection and hardware configuration are creator-reported. The independent reviewer checked only the public mapping, not the private media or machine.
The 02:26 performance claim is located consistently in the source map; the reviewer could not listen to certify its exact spoken onset or reproduce benchmark data.
The displayed retrieval example does not establish measured accuracy, recall or abstention performance. Cue timing is an unverified navigation aid.
Immediate note recall is distinguished from untested restart persistence, correction and deletion. Reviewer did not inspect source media or the running application.
Visible timer, note and app-opening actions are not evidence of permission enforcement or failure handling; timing is not listening-certified.
The zero-cloud privacy indicator is application-reported, not independently observed outbound traffic. This additional cue is not a network test.

sourceCoverage.rationale: All six material claims and seven cue-map entries are addressed. The reviewer checked internal mapping, not the inaccessible private media or listening-certified transcript.

supportingArgument.rationale: The analysis distinguishes inference locality from application-wide network isolation, reliable retrieval, durable memory and safe tool execution.

evidenceRoles.rationale: The demonstration is primary evidence only of creator presentation. Official Ollama documentation supports configuration distinctions, not this application's reported outcomes.

counterargument.rationale: The demonstration is recognized as a useful integration prototype. It is not faulted for lacking claims or enterprise qualification tests the creator did not perform.

tradeoffs.rationale: Local inference affords more owner control and avoids some API charges, while shifting hardware, network, maintenance and reliability duties onto the operator.

falsifiability.rationale: Network blocking, controlled retrieval questions, changed memory, denied tool actions and reproducible performance measurements are concrete proposed tests.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The original distinction is architectural: locality is a property, independence an operational claim, and trustworthiness a separately testable outcome.

performance.rationale: The claimed 20–30 tokens per second is creator-reported and explicitly unbenchmarked; proposed first-token, output, memory and task-duration measures are not fabricated results.

economics.rationale: Free local API usage is separated from hardware, electricity, storage and owner maintenance costs. No unsupported cost comparison is asserted.

threatGovernance.rationale: Tool permissions, argument validation, denied actions, prompt-injection exposure, interruption and execution receipts are raised as tests before granting operational authority.

gaps.rationale: Independent reviewer could not access the private verified media or Whisper aid and YouTube retrieval was throttled. Source timestamps remain publisher-inspected ASR navigation aids, not listening-certified evidence. The pack manifest and VTT are distinct digests, and section locators now point to the common video section with reduced navigation precision.
The demonstrated JARVIS system was not independently installed, audited for outbound traffic, benchmarked, or tested for memory and tool safety. Creator-reported claims remain unverified.
The publisher's narrow-mobile browser witness was not completed in the constrained cloud execution environment; the available desktop preview was inspected separately.

decisionRationale: Accept for Tony's editorial decision based on substantive source-qualified analysis and the actual independent reviewer findings. The review does not certify private media, source timestamps or observed system behavior; no owner GitHub acceptance has been posted.
